reason: VALUE/TRANSFER lens; arithmetic in scratchpad lowdet_val.py; J_pub 0.36 is fixed and public G = 20/40/60 is a guess. (1) The addressable pool is smaller than claimed. Of the 132 lab FN divisions, 23 have no second-daughter node, and the 12 'claimed by unscored relink' already have a node at the daughter (r1_hyp_divisions.notes.md AUDIT). The patch's own rule '>2 um from any node, never touch existing nodes' excludes those 12. So the share is 17%, not 27%. At public precision 0.5 the public FN is 8.8/17.5/26.2, which gives 1.5/3.0/4.6 missing-daughter events in the whole public test. The ceiling (all found, 0 FP) is +0.006..+0.0095 at G=40 (the idea says +0.011), +0.016 at G=20 and +0.005 at G=60. (2) The realistic capture is tiny. The patch caps at 2-4 parents per video, chosen by DaughterNet rank. The comparable measured insertion recovered 4/71 FN (5.6%) at 4/15 = 27% evaluable precision, which is the 0.265 break-even (CONTEXT; v2 notes). Mirror/sister geometry adds no separation: AUDIT3b has mirror 7.2 vs 7.1 um for TP vs FP. So precision rests on DaughterNet p alone, applied to parents WITHOUT a visible orphan, a pool whose prior is lower than the orphan pool's (1.2%). E[public TP] = (1.5-4.6 events) x (10-20% ranked recall, generous vs 5.6%) x (0.5-0.7 peak still present on an unseen embryo) = 0.1-0.6. Evaluable FP: 100-200 added forks x ~3% evaluable (15/466 in the lab) x (1-p) = 2-4. The official formula gives +1 TP/+2 FP = +0.0003..+0.0010, +1/+3 = -0.0001..-0.0003 and +0.5/+2 = -0.0002..-0.0008. Net public -0.001..+0.001, centred at ~0. The idea's own realistic case (+2 TP/+3 FP) needs 3-10x the measured recall and is still only +0.0007..+0.0031. (3) Transfer: the evidence (B35 151/151 at 0.90) comes from a detector trained on all 199 train videos, so daughter sub-threshold peaks there are inflated. On unseen embryos the peak at the true daughter is weaker, and the background of 0.3-0.9 peaks (+24% nodes already at 0.90, up to 73% in one video) grows. Precision drops exactly where the gain would come from. This is a confidence-trusting rule of the kind measured twice as lab +0.01..+0.016 -> LB 0. The lab stand-in is exp39's graph with a single-pass 0.90 cache, not x138's graph. x138's readmit (>=0.965 within 4 um of open ends) and gapfill (>=0.5) already consume part of this lowdet pool, so the x138 addressable set is unmeasured, and no x138 lab cache exists. (4) The gate cannot be validated. There are 23 addressable lab events, of which 44b6 holds only ~3-4, counted twice where crops overlap one recording. dTP >= +3 with precision >= 0.30 per embryo means n ~ 5-10 evaluable forks, with a binomial 95% CI of about 0.07-0.65, which cannot separate 0.30 from the 0.265 break-even. The LB adopt rule '>= base + 0.003' would fire only on noise (noise 0.003, effect <= 0.001). (5) Private: the private J is likely lab-like (0.12-0.2) with a larger D, so per-TP value is lower and the break-even is 0.11-0.17. That is slightly friendlier to insertions, but in-sample precision inflation dominates: ~0 (range -0.0005..+0.001). Node-multiplier cost is negligible: <= 8 nodes per video at 1/204-1/1397 of a TP edge.
